notes.title: 1.5.0 Update
notes.content:
Complete weapon recoil adjustment
The "Event" map is available again
Bug fixes

notes.title: 1.3.7 Special Update
notes.content:
[b]Haval map changes:[/b]
Fixed crooked ground on the map.
Fixed flying grass.
Fixed bulging windows.
Air conditioners are now quieter.

[b]Pripyat Map Changes:[/b]
In dominance mode, the central avenue has received a large number of obstacles, which will prevent buffs from getting into the bushes.

[b]Maps and modes:[/b]
Haval is available in Deathmatch, Gun Game modes.
Pripyat Night is available in Gun Game mode.

[b]Technical components:[/b]
Light grenade now ignores invisible walls.
Grenades ignore player colliders.
On night maps, the torch will be switched on automatically.
On some night maps, street lights will switch on automatically.
Invisible wall colliders have been corrected.

[b]Private servers:[/b]
Added images of selectable map next to the name.

[b]Voice Chat:[/b]
Completely redesigned the voice chat system.
Added ability to adjust voice chat volume.
Added ability to amplify voice chat.
Changed the in-game voice chat interface.

[b]Automated Lobby:[/b]
Lobby can create rooms.
Lobby gathers players from different regions to the optimal region.
Lobby controls game time, number of players, map size.

[b]Sound components:[/b]
Increased stock voice chat volume.
Improved spatial sound system, 7.1 support.

notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.content: Added a new map ‘Haval’ for the modes ‘Competitive’ and ‘Team Deathmatch’. Fixed bugs in competitive mode. Fixed localisation. Fixed minicart, and some colliders. Changed hitboxes.

notes.title: 1.2.0 - Patch
notes.content:
- Added competitive mode
- Disabled unnecessary regions
- Temporarily disabled the level system for accessing weapons
- Changed observer mode interface

notes.title: Available at Steam
notes.content:
Warfare Battleground - was released on May 1, 2024 at 00:00 PM MSK. At the moment the game can be purchased on Steam without any problems. Version 1.1.3 Stable - has no visible problems, but we are sure that there are still problems that players will find. Please report any bugs you find to us by email, or in the Discord community. Also we will periodically hold some events for players, where you can say your wishes, and ideas, and perhaps - the developers will add them to the game. 

Warfare Battleground is our first indie project. And we want to hear any criticism, be it good or bad. In our opinion this is a good way to develop the game. 

We hope the game will leave you with positive feelings. Enjoy the game.
